device_network: offline — every external artifact is fetched on the Mac and pushed over adb

proot.source: built locally from the pinned OpenMinis PRoot fork — never downloaded

node_runtime.provider: Alpine apk packages, branch v3.21, architecture aarch64
node_runtime.resolve_closure_command: docker run --rm --platform linux/arm64 -v <apks-dir>:/out alpine:3.21.3 sh -c 'apk update -q && apk fetch --recursive --output /out nodejs'
node_runtime.apk_closure_note: The authoritative closure is whatever `apk fetch --recursive nodejs` returns at pin time (nodejs plus its shared-library dependencies). After the first `stage-spike.sh --step fetch` + `--step verify` run, paste the generated build/staging/spike-pins.candidate.json apk_closure array here verbatim.

next_template.lockfile: template/package-lock.json — commit it after the first stage run; its npm sha512 integrity entries are the per-package pins for the whole node_modules tree

swc_native_binding.version_rule: must equal resolved_next_version exactly (Next.js refuses mismatched native bindings)
